title: C# Questions & Answers - Reading Console Input Operations
sourceFile: Reading Console Input Operations - C# Questions & Answers - Sanfoundry.html
description: This section of our 1000+ C# multiple choice questions focuses on reading console input operations in C# Programming Language.

questions.question: Which exception is thrown by the Read() method if an I/O failure occurs?
questions.explanation: In C#, methods in the System.IO namespace and Console class throw a System.IO.IOException when a read/write error occurs.

questions.question: Which method is used to read a single character from the standard input stream?
questions.explanation: Console.Read() reads the next character from the standard input stream and returns its Unicode value as an integer.

questions.question: Which method is used to read a full line of characters (as a string) from the console?
questions.explanation: Console.ReadLine() reads the next line of characters from the input stream and returns it as a string. It returns null if the end of the stream is reached.

questions.question: Which stream class is designed to write character data into a string (specifically a StringBuilder)?
questions.explanation: StringWriter allows you to treat a StringBuilder like a stream, enabling you to write character data into it using standard stream methods.

questions.question: Which method in the Console class allows reading a single key press directly from the keyboard without waiting for the Enter key?
questions.explanation: ReadKey() is non-line-buffered, meaning it captures the keystroke immediately as the user presses it, returning a ConsoleKeyInfo object.

questions.question: What happens if Console.ReadLine() encounters a physical I/O error?
questions.explanation: Standard library methods in .NET throw a System.IO.IOException when a hardware or stream error occurs during a read operation.

questions.question: What will happen when executing the following code if the user enters a full name (e.g., 'Harsh')?

options.text: Runs successfully but prints only the first letter
Runs successfully and prints the full name

questions.explanation: Convert.ToChar(string) only works if the string has exactly one character. If the user enters a longer string (like 'Harsh'), it will throw a System.FormatException at runtime.

questions.question: Which method is used to read a single byte from a file stream?
questions.explanation: The ReadByte() method of the Stream/FileStream class reads a single byte from the current position and returns it as an integer, or -1 if at the end of the stream.

questions.question: Which method is used to read a block or an array of bytes from a stream?
questions.explanation: The Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) method is used to read a specific number of bytes into a byte array.
